The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following reliefs:-
(i) For issuance of an appropriate writ(s)/ order(s) and/ or direction(s),

particularly a
writ of mandamus upon the respondents to conduct fair, proper and speedy
investigation of Kotwali P.S. Case No.200 of 2023 dated 21.06.2023 registered for
offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 313 and 34 of the Indian Penal
Code;

(ii) For a direction upon respondent No.6 to file status report of the investigation
carried out by the respondent in connection with Kotwali P.S. Case No.200 of 2023
including the steps taken by the respondent no.6 to apprehend the named accused
persons.

3.  In above view of the matter, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present writ petition with a liberty to work out her remedy in accordance with law.
5. Accordingly, the present criminal writ petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid liberty.
